description: This file defines the 'DayOfWeekField' class within the 'Cron' namespace, which manages schedule logic related to days of the week for cron-like job scheduling. It includes methods for checking if a date satisfies certain day-of-week conditions, validating input values, and incrementing dates for iteration.

classes.name: DayOfWeekField
classes.description: A class that handles the logic for day-of-week fields in cron scheduling, supporting special syntax like 'L' (last), '#' (nth occurrence), ranges, and combinators.

methods.name: isSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if a given date satisfies the day-of-week schedule rules based on the provided value.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Adjusts the date by one day forward or backward depending on the 'invert' parameter.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the string value for correctness according to allowed cron day-of-week patterns.

methods.name: convertLiterals
methods.description: Converts day name literals (e.g., SUN, MON) into their numeric representations.
